title: Ctrl+Shift+Enter adds an empty pane beside the new terminal
body:
Jack reports on 2026-11-06 that Ctrl+Shift+Enter adds two panes, a terminal and an empty pane beside it.

`new_terminal_pane` in `src/compositor.rs` asks `Layout::unique_name("terminal")` for a name. The anchor `terminal` already holds that name, so it gets `terminal2`. It adds an empty `Kind::Transient` pane under that name and starts ghostty with `--class=decade.terminal2`. On ghostty's first commit, `commit` calls `Layout::place(app_id)` in `src/panes.rs` to find the waiting pane. `place` matches only `Kind::Anchor` panes, so it finds none, and `commit` adds a second transient pane named `decade.terminal2` for the window.

## Proposal

`place` also matches a `Kind::Transient` pane with no toplevel whose name, prefixed with `decade.`, equals the app id.
